notes: WRONG INSTAGRAM: @_thegraveler_ is a creative printing and packaging studio in Bangladesh, not this race; clear the handle and follower data. Real event: 132 km gravel race from Hanmer Springs run by CJMS Events (John Moore), annual each February since at least 2025. Local sponsor roster includes Lifecare Medical Service; charity beneficiaries are Canterbury West Coast Air Rescue Trust and Ronald McDonald House Charities NZ (not sponsors).
